papers.title_zh: DiaLLM：由电子健康档案增强、用于临床检查推荐与诊断预测的临床对话系统
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展让医疗咨询取得了显著进步。然而现有医学 LLM 忽视了电子健康档案（EHR）的关键作用，且主要聚焦诊断推荐，临床适用性受限。我们提出 DiaLLM——首个把异构 EHR 数据整合进「有临床依据的对话」的医学 LLM，可完成临床检查推荐、结果解读与诊断预测，从而更贴合真实医疗实践。为从 EHR 构造有临床依据的对话，我们设计了临床检查参照（CTR）策略：把每个临床编码映射到其对应描述，并把检查结果归类为「正常」或「异常」。此外，DiaLLM 采用强化学习框架来取证与自动诊断；为处理巨大的动作空间，引入拒绝采样策略以减少冗余、提升探索效率；并设计了确认奖励与类敏感诊断奖励来引导准确的诊断预测。大量实验表明，DiaLLM 在临床检查推荐与诊断预测上均优于基线。代码已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: Defense Against Prompt Injection Attack by Leveraging Attack Techniques
papers.abstract: With the advancement of technology, large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across various natural language processing (NLP) tasks, powering LLM-integrated applications like Microsoft Copilot. However, as LLMs continue to evolve, new vulnerabilities, especially prompt injection attacks arise. These attacks trick LLMs into deviating from the original input instructions and executing the attacker’s instructions injected in data content, such as retrieved results. Recent attack methods leverage LLMs’ instruction-following abilities and their inabilities to distinguish instructions injected in the data content, and achieve a high attack success rate (ASR). When comparing the attack and defense methods, we interestingly find that they share similar design goals, of inducing the model to ignore unwanted instructions and instead to execute wanted instructions. Therefore, we raise an intuitive question: Could these attack techniques be utilized for defensive purposes? In this paper, we invert the intention of prompt injection methods to develop novel defense methods based on previous training-free attack methods, by repeating the attack process but with the original input instruction rather than the injected instruction. Our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our defense techniques outperform existing defense approaches, achieving state-of-the-art results.

papers.title_zh: 借力攻击技术来防御提示注入攻击
papers.abstract_zh: 随着技术进步，大语言模型（LLM）在各类自然语言处理任务上表现卓越，支撑起 Microsoft Copilot 这类集成 LLM 的应用。但随着 LLM 持续演进，新的脆弱性不断出现，提示注入攻击尤为突出：这类攻击诱使 LLM 偏离原始输入指令，转而去执行攻击者注入在数据内容（例如检索结果）中的指令。近期攻击方法利用 LLM 的指令跟随能力、以及其难以分辨「注入在数据内容中的指令」这一缺陷，取得很高的攻击成功率（ASR）。在对比攻防方法时我们有趣地发现：二者的设计目标其实相似——都是让模型忽略不想要的指令、转而执行想要的指令。由此我们提出一个直觉性的问题：能否把攻击技术用于防御？本文反转提示注入方法的意图，在此前「免训练攻击方法」的基础上构建新的防御方法：重复攻击流程，但把目标换成原始输入指令而非被注入的指令。大量实验表明，我们的防御技术优于现有防御方案，取得当前最优结果。

papers.title: Ontology-Guided Reverse Thinking Makes Large Language Models Stronger on Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in natural language processing. However, in knowledge graph question answering tasks (KGQA), there remains the issue of answering questions that require multi-hop reasoning. Existing methods rely on entity vector matching, but the purpose of the question is abstract and difficult to match with specific entities. As a result, it is difficult to establish reasoning paths to the purpose, which leads to information loss and redundancy. To address this issue, inspired by human reverse thinking, we propose Ontology-Guided Reverse Thinking (ORT), a novel framework that constructs reasoning paths from purposes back to conditions. ORT operates in three key phases: (1) using LLM to extract purpose labels and condition labels, (2) constructing label reasoning paths based on the KG ontology, and (3) using the label reasoning paths to guide knowledge retrieval. Experiments on the WebQSP and CWQ datasets show that ORT achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly enhances the capability of LLMs for KGQA.
papers.curator_note: 本体引导逆序推理增强知识图谱问答
papers.venue_full: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.title_zh: 本体引导的逆向思维让大模型在知识图谱问答上更强
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在自然语言处理上能力出众，但在知识图谱问答（KGQA）任务中，对需要多跳推理的问题仍存在回答不好的情况。现有方法依赖实体向量匹配，但「问题的目的」是抽象的，难以与具体实体相匹配；于是很难建立起通向该目的的推理路径，造成信息丢失与冗余。为解决这一问题，受人类逆向思维启发，我们提出本体引导的逆向思考（ORT）——一个从「目的」反向构造推理路径回到「条件」的新框架。ORT 分三个关键阶段：（1）用 LLM 抽取目的标签与条件标签；（2）基于 KG 本体构建标签层面的推理路径；（3）用这些标签推理路径引导知识检索。在 WebQSP 与 CWQ 数据集上的实验表明，ORT 取得当前最优性能，并显著增强 LLM 处理 KGQA 的能力。

papers.title: Advancing Collaborative Debates with Role Differentiation through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Multi-agent collaborative tasks exhibit exceptional capabilities in natural language applications and generation. By prompting agents to assign clear roles, it is possible to facilitate cooperation and achieve complementary capabilities among LLMs. A common strategy involves adopting a relatively general role assignment mechanism, such as introducing a “judge” or a “summarizer”. However, these approaches lack task-specific role customization based on task characteristics. Another strategy involves decomposing the task based on domain knowledge and task characteristics, followed by assigning appropriate roles according to LLMs’ respective strengths, such as programmers and testers. However, in some given tasks, obtaining domain knowledge related to task characteristics and getting the strengths of different LLMs is hard. To solve these problems, we propose a Multi-LLM Cooperation (MLC) framework with automatic role assignment capabilities. The core idea of the MLC is to initialize role assignments randomly and then allow the role embeddings to be learned jointly with the downstream task. To capture the state transitions of multiple LLMs during turn-based speaking, the role embedding is sequence-aware. At the same time, to avoid role convergence, the role differentiation module in MLC encourages behavioral differentiation between LLMs while ensuring the LLM team consistency, guiding different LLMs to develop complementary strengths from the optimization level. Our experiments on seven datasets demonstrate that MLC significantly enhances collaboration and expertise, which collaboratively addresses multi-agent tasks.
papers.curator_note: 角色分化的多智能体强化学习促进协作辩论
papers.venue_full: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.title_zh: 用多智能体强化学习推进「角色分化」的协作辩论
papers.abstract_zh: 多智能体协作任务在自然语言应用与生成中表现出众。通过提示各智能体分派明确角色，可以促进协作并在多个 LLM 之间形成能力互补。一种常见策略是采用较为通用的角色分配机制，例如引入「评委」或「总结者」，但这类做法缺少依据任务特性做任务专属的角色定制。另一种策略是基于领域知识与任务特性分解任务，再按各 LLM 的所长分派合适角色（如程序员与测试员），但在某些给定任务中，很难获得与任务特性相关的领域知识，也难以了解不同 LLM 各自的优势。为解决这些问题，我们提出具备自动角色分配能力的多 LLM 协作（MLC）框架。其核心思想是：先随机初始化角色分配，再让角色嵌入与下游任务联合学习。为刻画多个 LLM 在轮流发言中的状态转移，角色嵌入是序列感知的；同时为避免角色收敛，MLC 中的角色分化模块在保证 LLM 团队一致性的前提下，鼓励各 LLM 行为分化，从优化层面引导不同 LLM 发展出互补的能力。在七个数据集上的实验表明，MLC 显著增强了协作与专业化水平，能够协同求解多智能体任务。

papers.title: GNN-RAG: Graph Neural Retrieval for Efficient Large Language Model Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) enhances the context of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating information retrieved from the Knowledge Graph (KG). Most recent approaches rely on costly LLM calls to generate executable relation paths or traverse the KG, which is inefficient in complex KGQA tasks, such as those involving multi-hop or multi-entity questions. We introduce the GNN-RAG framework, which utilizes lightweight Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for effective and efficient graph retrieval. The GNN learns to assign importance weights to nodes based on their relevance to the question, as well as the relevance of their neighboring nodes. This enables the framework to effectively handle context from deeper parts of the graph, improving retrieval performance. GNN-RAG retrieves the shortest paths connecting question entities to GNN answer candidates, providing this information as context for the LLM. Experimental results show that GNN-RAG achieves effective retrieval on two widely used KGQA benchmarks (WebQSP and CWQ), outperforming or matching GPT-4 performance with a 7B tuned LLM. Additionally, GNN-RAG excels on multi-hop and multi-entity questions outperforming LLM-based retrieval approaches by 8.9–15.5% points at answer F1. Furthermore, it surpasses long-context inference while using 9× fewer KG tokens. The code is provided in https://github.com/cmavro/GNN-RAG .

papers.venue_full: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.title_zh: GNN-RAG：面向高效知识图谱大模型推理的图神经检索
papers.abstract_zh: 知识图谱问答（KGQA）中的检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入从知识图谱检索到的信息来扩充大语言模型（LLM）的上下文。多数最新方法依赖代价高昂的 LLM 调用来生成可执行的关系路径或遍历知识图谱，这在复杂 KGQA 任务（如涉及多跳或多实体的问题）上效率很低。我们提出 GNN-RAG 框架，用轻量的图神经网络（GNN）实现有效且高效的图检索：GNN 学习根据节点与问题的相关性、以及其邻居节点的相关性为节点赋重要性权重，使框架能够有效利用图中更深层的上下文，提升检索性能。GNN-RAG 检索连接「问题实体」与「GNN 候选答案」的最短路径，并把这些信息作为上下文提供给 LLM。实验结果表明，GNN-RAG 在两个广泛使用的 KGQA 基准（WebQSP 与 CWQ）上都能有效检索，用一个 7B 微调 LLM 即可超越或匹敌 GPT-4 的表现；在多跳与多实体问题上尤其出色，答案 F1 比基于 LLM 的检索方法高 8.9–15.5 个百分点；此外它在只用九分之一知识图谱 token 的情况下超越了长上下文推理。代码见 https://github.com/cmavro/GNN-RAG。
